```{r }
#| include: true
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- p.gmdp
ID.target <- .resolveUhsIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "UHS.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
Sa.log   <- TRUE
Tn.log   <- TRUE
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Uniform hazard spectra for maximum horizontal pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa(Tn) [g] with 5%% critical damping, reference site conditions Vs30 = %s m/s, and return period TR = %s yr."
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::pandoc_to("docx")
#| include: true
TR.target <- 10000
Vs30.target <- Vs30.gmdp
p.target <- "mean"
Vs30.label <- paste(Vs30.target, collapse = ", ")
```
